_description: Simulated checkpoint.json from a FULL-scope feature run that completed before pipeline-quickwins-hardening-r1 shipped. No stage carries an execution_mode field — the field did not exist as a first-class checkpoint schema entry before ADR-0057. Per ADR-0057's absence-default rule, each absent stage maps to specialist-dispatch at resume time. Expected: FR-2 self-check passes with no diagnostic.
_note: No stage above carries an execution_mode field. This models a checkpoint written before ADR-0057 promoted execution_mode to a first-class documented field. Per ADR-0057 absence-default rule: absence == specialist-dispatch for all stages.
